text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer!?
I-I-It is nothing of consequence at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Everyone in the classroom was getting hyped up over s-scary stories, so I fled... No, that's not it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I had some business I absolutely couldn't miss,
so I had to take my leave!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, what a shame!
I wanted to hear even more scary stories, you know~!
choice_data_list: ...Aren't you just putting on a brave face?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I-I am not putting on a tough front!
I really, truly am perfectly fine!?
"She didn't seem to be putting on a tough front, but for a while after that, she appeared unwell."
